evidence.quote: Missing browser feature is https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/RegExp/hasIndices. ... The kind of errors you are seeing indicate that you are using a very outdated browser engine.

confirmation.quote: Windows Update does _not_ update Edge, at least not in my setup. So although the _base systems_ were the same, the Edge browsers were not. I've updated Edge from within the appliaction and the issue is fixed.

notes: End user's client (outdated Edge engine) lacks a standard JS feature; fixed by updating the browser, no Gitea code or server config change. Not an upgrade regression (fresh 1.22.0 offline install).

reviews.decidable_why: The stack trace points to a missing browser feature (regex 'd' flag) inside vendored monaco, but the reporter claims 'latest' Edge, which is misleading without the thread.
The RegExp 'd' flag error strongly suggests an old browser engine, but the body claims 'latest' Edge, so confirming the outdated browser needed the thread.
